title: Pure Warrior Lady
summary: The Warrior Lady lore build uniting Warrior Lady of the Wasteland and her dimensional counterpart D.D. Warrior Lady alongside D.D. Assailant, D.D. Warrior, and generic EARTH Warrior support. Its core fighters banish both the opposing monster and themselves after damage calculation without targeting or destroying, then return through D.D.R. - Different Dimension Reincarnation.

summary.title: Starters
points: Warrior Lady of the Wasteland, when destroyed by battle and sent to the GY, Special Summons any EARTH Warrior with 1500 or less ATK from the Deck in Attack Position: D.D. Warrior, Goblindbergh, Amazoness Trainee, or another copy of herself.
Goblindbergh Special Summons a Level 4 Warrior from the hand on Normal Summon before switching to Defense Position, setting up Rank 4 Warrior Xyz plays or Link-2 Ferocious Flame Swordsman.
Reinforcement of the Army searches D.D. Warrior Lady, Warrior Lady of the Wasteland, D.D. Assailant, or Goblindbergh directly from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Goblindbergh + Level 4 Warrior
steps: Normal Summon Goblindbergh and Special Summon D.D. Warrior Lady or D.D. Assailant from the hand.
Overlay both Level 4 Warriors into Heroic Champion - Excalibur or Blade Armor Ninja, or Link Summon Ferocious Flame Swordsman to boost all Warriors on the field by 500 ATK.
Equip Moon Mirror Shield or set Dimensional Fissure and back up your remaining Warriors for the Battle Phase.

summary.title: Combat Banish & Recursion
summary.text: D.D. Warrior Lady, D.D. Assailant, and D.D. Warrior remove opposing threats in battle by banishing both monsters after damage calculation, bypassing destruction and targeting immunity. D.D. Warrior Lady's effect is optional, D.D. Assailant triggers when destroyed by battle, and D.D. Warrior's effect is mandatory. Once banished, D.D.R. - Different Dimension Reincarnation discards a card to Special Summon any of them back in Attack Position.

summary.title: Control & Bosses
points: Freed the Matchless General negates and destroys Spell Cards that target it, and during your Draw Phase it can search any Level 4 or lower Warrior from the Deck instead of your normal draw.

Heroic Champion - Excalibur detaches two materials to double its original ATK to 4000 until the end of the opponent's turn, while Blade Armor Ninja detaches one material to grant a Warrior two attacks per Battle Phase.
Amazoness Trainee places any monster it destroys by battle on the bottom of the opponent's Deck instead of sending it to the GY and gains 200 ATK each time.

summary.title: Spells
points: Moon Mirror Shield sets the equipped Warrior's ATK and DEF to the battling monster's highest stat plus 100 during damage calculation, letting D.D. Warrior Lady choose between winning by battle or banishing both monsters.
Dimensional Fissure banishes any monster sent to the GY, disrupting the opponent's graveyard while turning your own fallen Warriors into live targets for D.D.R. - Different Dimension Reincarnation.

Reinforcement of the Army's Troops Special Summons a Level 4 or lower Warrior from the hand whenever an Attack Position Warrior declares an attack, and The Warrior Returning Alive recovers a Warrior from the GY.

main: D.D. Warrior Lady

Signature Level 4 LIGHT Warrior (1500 ATK / 1600 DEF): after damage calculation, when this card battles an opponent's monster, you can banish that monster, also banish this card (non-targeting banish that works even when D.D. Warrior Lady attacks or is attacked!)!
Warrior Lady of the Wasteland

Signature Level 4 EARTH Warrior (1100 ATK / 1200 DEF): when this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY, Special Summons 1 EARTH Warrior monster with 1500 or less ATK (D.D. Warrior, Goblindbergh, Amazoness Trainee, or another Warrior Lady of the Wasteland!) directly from your Deck in Attack Position!
D.D. Assailant
Level 4 EARTH Warrior companion (1700 ATK / 1600 DEF): after damage calculation, when this card is destroyed by battle with an opponent's monster, banishes that monster, also banishes this card!
D.D. Warrior

Level 4 EARTH Warrior (1200 ATK / 1000 DEF; directly Special Summoned from your Deck by Warrior Lady of the Wasteland!): after damage calculation, when this card battles a monster, mandatory effect that banishes that monster and banishes this card!
Freed the Matchless General

Level 5 EARTH Warrior commander (2300 ATK; triggers Reinforcement of the Army's Troops!): negates any Spell Effect that targets this card and destroys it, and searches any Level 4 or lower Warrior Lady from your Deck during your Draw Phase!
Goblindbergh

Level 4 EARTH Warrior (1400 ATK; summonable by Warrior Lady of the Wasteland): Special Summons D.D. Warrior Lady or D.D. Assailant from your hand on Normal Summon to assemble Rank 4 Warrior Xyz plays.
Amazoness Trainee
Level 4 EARTH Warrior (1500 ATK; summonable by Warrior Lady of the Wasteland) that bottom-decks monsters it destroys by battle and gains 200 ATK each time.
D.D.R. - Different Dimension Reincarnation

Signature Equip Spell: discards 1 card to target 1 of your banished monsters (D.D. Warrior Lady, D.D. Assailant, or D.D. Warrior after they banish an opponent's boss monster!), Special Summons it in Attack Position, and equips to it!
Dimensional Fissure

Continuous Spell: any monster sent to the GY is banished instead—shutting down the opponent's graveyard while banishing your own Warriors so D.D.R. - Different Dimension Reincarnation can immediately Special Summon them!
Moon Mirror Shield
Equips to any Warrior Lady so she always wins combat by setting her ATK/DEF to the battling monster's stats + 100.
The Warrior Returning Alive
Normal Spell depicting Warrior Lady of the Wasteland that adds 1 Warrior monster from your GY back to your hand.
Reinforcement of the Army's Troops

Continuous Spell depicting Freed and Warrior Lady of the Wasteland: whenever an Attack Position Warrior monster you control declares an attack, Special Summons 1 Level 4 or lower Warrior monster from your hand!
Reinforcement of the Army
Limited to 1 in TCG: adds D.D. Warrior Lady, Warrior Lady of the Wasteland, D.D. Assailant, or Goblindbergh from your Deck to your hand.
extra: Rank 4 LIGHT Warrior Xyz (2 Level 4 Warrior monsters) that detaches 2 materials to double its original ATK to 4000 until the end of your opponent's turn.
Rank 4 WIND Warrior Xyz (2 Level 4 Warrior monsters) that detaches 1 material to allow a Warrior/Ninja to attack twice during the Battle Phase.
Link-2 FIRE Warrior that boosts all Warrior monsters on the field by 500 ATK and revives a non-Link Warrior from your GY when destroyed.
